prespec_cli_commands.identical_resume: same command with byte-identical candles parquet (expects idempotent re-verify, no new decisions)
prespec_cli_commands.known_bug: runner computes start_bar = last_bar_idx + 1 positionally (scripts/opencode_r77_advisor.py:108) and short-circuits 'nothing new' when start_bar >= len(df) (line 178), ignoring the timestamp watermark. A same-length shifted window (drop oldest, append 1 new closed bar) MUST settle the new bar after the W1 fix; on unfixed code it settles zero bars. Regression test asserts the fixed behavior and therefore FAILS-before (bug reproduced) / PASSES-after.

rolling_regression.expect_fixed: shifted resume settles exactly the 1 new closed bar (decision_log grows only if the new bar is grid-eligible, but settled-bar accounting advances and state watermarks move)
rolling_regression.expect_identical: identical-window resume is idempotent: no new decisions, no new intents, state re-verified, exit code 0

crash_recovery_matrix.kill_before_commit: process dies after streaming bars but before final state.json write -> restart from last periodic commit must resume without duplicating intents/alerts/fills (exactly-once by deterministic IDs)
crash_recovery_matrix.kill_after_commit_before_export: state.json committed but outputs (decisions.csv/summary.json) missing -> resume/rebuild must regenerate missing exports even with zero new candles
crash_recovery_matrix.kill_after_export: full outputs present -> resume is clean no-op re-verify
crash_recovery_matrix.corrupt_state: truncated/garbage state.json must FAIL CLOSED with a clear error (no silent resume), or recover from a verified last committed generation if present

stress_scenario.kind: scenario analysis, NOT a maker-fill probability claim
stress_scenario.path: incremental FeedExecAccount.on_bar_close (same path the integrated runner settles)
stress_scenario.adverse_rule: every fill price moved 10 bps against the trader vs the ohlc-v2 reference fill (entry limit crossed pays +10bps long / -10bps short; exits receive -10bps long / +10bps short). Fee/funding math unchanged (fee 0.0002/fill). Deterministic, versioned here.
stress_scenario.batch_counterpart: src/agentic_alpha_lab/backtest/engine.py run_backtest on the SAME candles+signals with reference fills
stress_scenario.supports: one bounded uniform-adverse-slip scenario with independent batch comparison
explicitly_unsupported: queue position / maker probability from OHLC
stress_scenario.rule: the stress matrix is NOT labelled PASS beyond this single bounded scenario

negative_controls.wrong_fee: fee 0.0002 -> 0.001 must CHANGE equity; parity-vs-reference assertion must FAIL (control working)
negative_controls.wrong_tp1: tp1_fraction 0.5 -> 0.75 must CHANGE exit split/accounting; parity must FAIL
negative_controls.wrong_timestamp: shifted close_time watermark must CHANGE settled-bar selection; equality assertion must FAIL
negative_controls.control_tamper: perturbed control equity trace must TRIP divergence/under-only guard or break parity; silent agreement must FAIL
negative_controls.rule: each negative control is SATISFIED only when the mismatch is DETECTED (assertion fails as required). Positive counts matter: EMPTY comparisons are EMPTY/NOT_EXERCISED, never passing trading evidence.
